thread:
elaine (Eng): quick help please. i moved from 80% -> 100% FTE on 09/15 and that bumped my PTO accrual rate mid-quarter. i was told my balance capped at 1.5x monthly accrual, but my dashboard shows i'm over cap. Can we use the extra days before year-end / shutdown?

ben (Manager): saw this too when approving. trying to make sure she can burn extra days before the company blackout week. how strict is the accrual cap enforcement?

mike (People Ops): short answer: we enforce accrual caps at month-end for bookkeeping. when FTE increases mid-month we prorate accrual for that month; however any pre-existing balance can appear to exceed the new cap until the next accounting run. we don't force-forfeit balances retroactively without notice.

zoe (Finance): policy detail: accrual caps are applied at the legal entity level during the month close (EOM). if an employee's balance exceeds the cap after a status change, we allow a one-time voluntary use window to reduce the balance before we trigger a forced conversion/forfeit. for year-end the voluntary window closes on 12/18.

elaine (Eng): so i can request to take PTO to bring me under cap before 12/18? managers ok with that?

mike (People Ops): yes. steps: 1) manager approves time in the thread. 2) employee submits PTO in WorkDay and adds comment "Accrual-reduction window". 3) people-ops gets notified and flags payroll. note: if dates overlap with company shutdown (12/24-12/27) special rules apply - see below.

ben (Manager): i approve the days if she wants them. prefer she takes 11/29-12/01 to avoid the shutdown.

elaine (Eng): i'd like 11/29-12/01. filing now. one other question: will this affect my accrual rate for next year?

zoe (Finance): taking PTO to reduce balance doesn't change your accrual rate; it only adjusts balance. accrual rate is determined by your current FTE and tenure and will apply to future months as normal. if you get close to cap again mid-year we'll send a heads-up.

payroll_bot: reminder: submit PTO in WorkDay and include comment "Accrual-reduction window" to auto-route to People Ops. Payroll cutoff for Nov adjustments: 11/20.

elaine (Eng): submitted PTO 11/29-12/01 with comment. screenshot attached in WorkDay.

mike (People Ops): got it. i'll tag payroll and monitor. note about shutdown: PTO days that fall during company shutdown are treated as regular paid time off, but using PTO to reduce accruals is allowed; however if you try to reduce by taking time within the official shutdown week we prefer you take days outside the shutdown to preserve shutdown policy.

zoe (Finance): confirming we received the update. if WorkDay records it by the payroll cutoff (11/20) it will reflect on the November close. if late, it will be in December reconciliation.

ben (Manager): thanks all. appreciate the clarity.

elaine (Eng): thanks, everyone. happy to shift if payroll needs an earlier date.

mike (People Ops): resolved for now. ping me if the dashboard still shows wrong balance after payroll run and we'll file a discrepancy ticket. :white_check_mark:
